mapper.select: SELECT account.id, account.username, account.password_hash, account.system_role, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.account_department_role AS role_assignment JOIN public.department AS department ON department.id = role_assignment.department_id AND department.active WHERE role_assignment.account_id = account.id AND role_assignment.role = 'DEPARTMENT_ADMIN' AND role_assignment.revoked_at IS NULL ) AS department_admin FROM public.account AS account WHERE lower(btrim(account.username)) = lower(btrim(#{username})) AND account.status = 'ACTIVE' AND account.password_hash IS NOT NULL
